item.title: Self-Hosted Process Sandboxing: Firejail vs Bubblewrap vs nsjail (2026)
item.description: Running untrusted or partially trusted code on Linux requires more than basic user permissions. Modern process sandboxing leverages Linux namespaces, seccomp-bpf filters, and cgroup resource limits to create isolated execution environments — without the overhead of full virtual machines or Docker containers.
